cohort: The participants were 2051 neonates admitted to the Kamuzu Central Hospital (KCH) Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) over 12 months, excluding those with congenital anomalies.
finding: The overall neonatal mortality rate was 23.1%, with lower birth weight and outborn status associated with increased mortality, and inborn infants exposed to antenatal corticosteroids had significantly lower odds of death (54% reduction) compared to those without exposure.
